Russell Brand faces scrutiny over prison statement and past allegations

Comedian Russell Brand is under investigation following an "appalling" prison statement he shared. An accuser stated the message was "an insult to victims." Separately, a woman who alleges she was raped by Brand at 16 said a change in consent laws would have made her safe. Other coverage noted Brand could face restricted calls after sharing the "completely unacceptable" message from jail.
